branch_scope: All future local experimental MiniMax-H3 image builds use this dedicated branch unless the user changes the convention.
migration: Replace the previous main-based recipe with the reviewed complete gateway service tree plus a sealed H3 upgrade. Commit normally on the existing experiment branch; preserve history and never force-push.
base_weights: Existing read-only mounts; not packaged in the image
local_network: Command-scoped GitHub proxy http://127.0.0.1:17890; never copied into Runner or Pod configuration
validation_boundary: Local recipe checks only until the actual CI build, final digest, registry pull, H100 and media E2E evidence are collected
framework_scope: Preserve colleague Gateway and telemetry; independently validate service compatibility after upgrading Omni. Four distilled experiment profiles use the native Omni endpoint; no new public Gateway LoRA contract is claimed.
